SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) yt_sum, SUM(anglers) anglers_sum, COUNT(*) n_boats
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy <= 60
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 2
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 8
